operations.name: cad.write_source
operations.description: Create or revise a part from OpenSCAD source. Saves the source as a new draft revision, renders it with OpenSCAD, and returns a measured geometry report (envelope, volume, watertightness, mid-plane cross-sections with holes/outlines, detected parameters, render warnings). Use this for every geometry change; then verify with cad.check.

expectedRevisionId.description: Revision read before this edit; conflicts fail without overwriting newer work.

artifactId.description: Existing mechanical artifact to revise. Omit to create a new part.

title.description: Part name; required when creating a new part (e.g. "Motor mount plate").

source.description: Complete OpenSCAD source as plain text (not base64). Model units are millimetres; +Z is up; the origin is the reference the request uses.

params.description: Optional parameter values to render with and record on the revision.

rationale.description: One line on what this revision changes and why.

operations.name: cad.read_source
operations.description: Read the OpenSCAD source of a part as plain text, with its top-level parameters and revision info. Use before modifying an existing part.

operations.name: cad.inspect
operations.description: Diagnostic measurements of a rendered part: envelope, volume, watertightness, body count, cross-sections and probe points. Does not bind request assertions or establish verification. Use cad.check to commit request-bound expectations.

params.description: Re-render with these overrides before measuring (nothing is committed).

axis.description: Axis normal to the cutting plane (axis-aligned cut).

at.description: Plane coordinate along that axis, in mm. Cut through the middle of the feature you want to see, not exactly on a face.

origin.description: Point on an oblique cutting plane [x,y,z] mm. Use with `normal` for inclined holes.

normal.description: Normal of an oblique cutting plane. Use with `origin` when the cut is not axis-aligned.

sections.description: Extra cutting planes to report, beyond the automatic mid-planes.

probes.description: Points (x,y,z) in mm to classify as solid or empty.

operations.name: cad.check
operations.description: Verify a part against explicit expectations derived from the request (envelope, volume, solid/empty points, holes and outlines in cross-sections, optional preserve vs the approved baseline or initial draft ancestor). Commits the request-bound assertion spec unless exploratory is true. Only verificationStatus passed establishes matching declared evidence. Scope changes require explicit human review; a raw pass does not establish readiness. Do not claim verified completion when status is scope_changed, partial, failed or unverified.

params.description: Check a parameter variant instead of the recorded values (nothing is committed).

bbox.description: Overall envelope: exact min and max corner in mm (default tolerance 0.1 mm).

volume.description: Expected solid volume in mm³ (default tolerance 1.5 %, which absorbs polygonal circle approximation).

solid.description: Points (x,y,z) that must lie inside material.

empty.description: Points (x,y,z) that must lie in empty space (e.g. hole centers, pockets, outside chamfers).

axis.description: Axis normal to the cutting plane.

at.description: Coordinate of the cutting plane along that axis (pick a plane through the middle of the feature, not on a face).

center.description: Hole center in the two in-plane axes (x,y for a z-section; x,z for a y-section; y,z for an x-section).

holes.description: Circular holes that must appear in this plane.

holeCount.description: Exact number of cut-out loops in this plane (catches missing or extra cuts).

outerCount.description: Exact number of separate material regions in this plane.

center.description: [a, b] in the two in-plane axes, in mm

size.description: [a, b] in the two in-plane axes, in mm

slots.description: Non-circular cut-outs (slots, pockets, windows) by bounding-box size and center.

center.description: [a, b] in the two in-plane axes, in mm

polygons.description: Regular-polygon cut-outs (e.g. hex nut traps) by side count and across-flats width; orientation-independent.

size.description: Rectangular outline size in the two in-plane axes.

center.description: [a, b] in the two in-plane axes, in mm

outer.description: Shape of the largest material region in this plane.

materialArea.description: Net material area in the plane (mm²).

sections.description: Cross-section assertions — the primary way to verify holes, bores, slots and wall outlines.

watertight.description: Require a closed manifold mesh (default true).

shells.description: Expected number of disconnected bodies (1 for a single part).

minRoundness.description: Minimum roundness for circular features, apothem/radius (default 0.97 ≈ $fn ≥ 13).

maxSelfIntersections.description: Fail if more than this many triangle pairs interpenetrate (0 = no self-intersection). Detects overlapping bodies that still look like a valid bbox/volume.

center.description: Center of a sphere (mm) that is allowed to change.

changeRegions.description: Regions where the edit is allowed; everything else must match the approved baseline (or initial draft ancestor).

preserve.description: Require unrelated geometry to match the approved baseline (or initial draft ancestor) (sampled points outside changeRegions).

expect.description: What must be true of the part, taken from the request: envelope, volume, solid/empty points, cross-section holes and outlines.

exploratory.description: Use true on the first check for a new request to trial the complete request-derived expectations without binding them. Fix source that violates the request; correct mistaken assertions only against the request, never to fit measured output. After the trial passes, repeat the same complete expect with false to commit verification. Existing committed scope remains binding. Default false: request-bound.

operations.name: cad.patch_source
operations.description: Replace one unique snippet in an existing part's OpenSCAD source and re-render. Use for a small, local edit instead of rewriting the whole file. The snippet must appear exactly once.

expectedRevisionId.description: Revision read before this edit; conflicts fail without overwriting newer work.

oldString.description: Exact snippet to replace. Must occur exactly once in the current source.

newString.description: Replacement text (may be empty to delete the snippet).

rationale.description: One line on what this edit changes and why.

operations.name: cad.set_param
operations.description: Change one file-scope OpenSCAD assignment (name = value;) and re-render. Prefer this over rewriting the whole file when only a dimension changes.

expectedRevisionId.description: Revision read before this edit; conflicts fail without overwriting newer work.

name.description: File-scope parameter name from cad.read_source (e.g. hole_d).

value.description: New literal value written into the source assignment.

rationale.description: One line on why this dimension changed.

operations.name: cad.compose
operations.description: Place existing parts together with translate/rotate (no mates, no STEP). Each part's source is wrapped in a module so its variables stay isolated. Returns a new mechanical artifact with the combined mesh.

revisionId.description: Pin the part revision placed in this snapshot.

instances.description: Parts to place. Each source is wrapped in its own module so file-scope names do not collide.

rationale.description: One line on why these parts are placed together.
